checks.explanation: D-selection is printed on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, authorizations and permits, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
The list shows Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead and no other mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead.
No D-embalming disclosure text appears in the disclosures array.
The list contains no statement that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket funeral.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so it is on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered with an option using a container provided by the purchaser, and no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions transportation to crematory and cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is listed.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have itemized prices, and no other offered good or service lacks its own price line.
The list contains only required itemized charges for forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial and no optional package price.
The list contains no assertion that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the prescribed disclosure wording.
The list contains no claim about delaying decomposition or protecting the body from gravesite substances.
No other printed text undercuts a required disclosure, and disclosures are presented as regular readable text.
